public_rationale: Marcus clearly alleges a large shortfall against initial promises. But the passage does not identify those promises or give a sufficiently definite ordinary standard for judging their overall fulfillment. Individual promises can be checked; selecting and weighting them would determine the verdict on this broader sentence. Neither documented failures nor successful applications alone settle it. The claim therefore cannot fairly receive a factual grade as written.
limitations: This does not establish that Marcus's criticism is wrong.
The contextual announcement is not treated as representative of all initial LLM promises.
No verdict is inferred from capabilities developed after the post.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs do not come close to delivering what was initially promised.

statement.excerpt: They do not deliver remotely what was initially promised of them.
statement.document_title: Hard-forked! Casey Newton’s distorted portrait of Gary Marcus and AI skepticism

from_speaker: what was initially promised of them
our_interpretation: The sentence describes a substantial gap between initial promises and LLM capabilities at the time of the December 6, 2024 post.
Marcus does not identify the promises, who made them, what counts as initial, or how to assess delivery across different capabilities.
The surrounding acknowledgment of writing and coding uses rules out treating this as a claim that LLMs deliver nothing useful.
Selecting a representative set of promises and deciding their relative importance would supply substantive criteria that Marcus did not give. No such selection is imposed.
criteria.support_condition: A support test would require an identifiable promised baseline and an ordinary standard for a substantial overall shortfall by the post date. The passage does not establish either sufficiently to score the claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A contradiction test would require the same baseline and evidence that LLMs substantially delivered it by the post date. Demonstrating selected useful capabilities would not by itself contradict this claim.
